verdict.rationale: Kling documents native output up to 4K for video generation (VIDEO 3.0 / 3.0 Omni), which covers the 1080p-or-above resolution requirement with no external upscaling. The evidence never mentions selectable aspect ratios (16:9, 9:16, 1:1), so the channel-format half of the story is unproven. missing for 10: documented 16:9/9:16/1:1 aspect-ratio selection, confirmation that 4K/1080p applies in every aspect ratio, independent or hands-on corroboration of native output specs.
